title: Jami: decentralized video calls and messaging without servers

intro.headline: HD video calls and messages with zero centralized servers.
intro.subhead: Jami connects your devices directly using distributed hash tables (DHT) and end-to-end encryption — no phone number or central server needed.

outro.headline: Communicate with complete autonomy.
outro.subhead: No central point of failure, no corporate server to intercept your stream. Clean P2P calls for everyone.
